**Resubmitted with the deterministic failure repaired.**

**Repair made in operative language:** the duration is now written as "twelve **(12)** months after their involvement ends" inside § 12.4 itself, so the ≤ 12-month check reads a number rather than a spelled-out term. Nothing else in the substance changed, and the comment was aligned to the same figure.

**Revised § 12.4 as rendered (validated ok:true, minimality ok):**
> 12.4 Neither Party shall solicit the other's personnel directly involved in the Services for twelve (12) months after their involvement ends. General advertisements, unsolicited approaches, and hiring are not restricted.

**Element coverage (fallback, all six by operation 1):**
- Mutual — "Neither Party"
- Scope — "personnel directly involved in the Services"
- Duration — "twelve (12) months after their involvement ends"
- General advertisements carve-out; unsolicited approaches carve-out; hiring expressly not restricted (no-hire verbs "hire, or employ" and the anti-carve-out phrase "regardless of how the employee applies" deleted)

Classification remains **deviation** on the original 24-month all-personnel no-hire (walk-away territory), with § 12.3's Customer-favourable acknowledgements and the separate non-compete at p0046 untouched.
